records.subject: Tourism
records.title: Tourism Receipts By Major Components (Year-To-Date), Quarterly
records.footnote: Data are year-to-date figures, i.e., refer to the period from the first day of the calendar year up to the current date.  STB has reviewed the methodology for data collection and computation of tourism receipts so as to better capture tourism performance.  Tourism Receipts from 2016  have been updated based on the revised methodology.  Comparison of data before and after 2016 is not recommended.

row.footnote: Sightseeing, Entertainment & Gaming (SEG) includes entrance fees to attractions and nightspots, expenditure on day-tours, leisure events as well as entertainment at the Integrated Resorts.
Other TR components include expenditure on airfares on Singapore-based carriers, port taxes, local transportation, business, medical, education, transit visitors and COVID-19 related costs.
